entities.summary: Tatsuki Fujimoto (b. 1993-10-10, Nikaho) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nikaho and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
